chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Malik ibn Atiyya, from Abu Hamza, from Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him) who said:
I wish, by Allah, that I could redeem two characteristics in our Shia with part of the flesh of my arm: rashness and scarcity of concealment.

key_terms.النَّزَكَ: Rashness, hasty action or speech, impulsiveness

ai.seo_question: What are the two negative characteristics in the Shia that Imam Ali wished to redeem?
ai.summary: Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn (AS) identifies 'rashness' (al-nazaq) and 'lack of concealment' (qillat al-kitman) as critical flaws in the Shia community, linking them to the broader principle of *al-kitman* (guarding secrets) essential for survival during periods of political oppression. This hadith underscores the necessity of emotional and verbal restraint, ensuring that private matters are not disclosed prematurely, thereby preserving the community's integrity and strategic advantage.
